description: MainActivity for an Android-based AI Calculator app, handling UI setup, user interactions, voice input, theme toggling, and basic expression evaluation with placeholders for backend integration.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity class serving as the main screen for the AI calculator app, managing UI, speech input, theme, and calculation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, theme, listeners, and history list.

methods.name: setupTheme
methods.description: Applies dark or light theme styling to the UI components.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between dark and light themes.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Binds click listeners for UI controls like buttons.

methods.name: setupHistoryList
methods.description: Initializes the calculation history list adapter.

methods.name: fillFromHistory
methods.description: Fills the input field with a previous calculation from history.

methods.name: toggleHistoryPanel
methods.description: Shows or hides the calculation history panel.

methods.name: processUserQuery
methods.description: Handles user input, performs evaluation, updates UI and history.

methods.name: showResult
methods.description: Displays calculation result and AI explanation.

methods.name: addToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation to the history list.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Performs basic expression evaluation, with placeholder logic, to simulate backend calculations.

methods.name: startVoiceInput
methods.description: Requests permission and initiates speech recognition for voice input.

properties.name: root
properties.description: Root view of the activity layout.

properties.name: historyPanel
properties.description: Container for the calculation history list.
